name: Emeryville Crescent SMR
description: Emeryville Crescent State Marine Reserve protects tidal marsh and mudflats on the east shore of San Francisco Bay, at the south end of McLaughlin Eastshore State Park. It is a protected area for birds and other wildlife.
fullDescription: Emeryville Crescent State Marine Reserve protects tidal marsh and mudflats on the east shore of San Francisco Bay, at the south end of McLaughlin Eastshore State Park. It is a protected area for birds and other wildlife.
whatTheyOffer:
- Shoreline views of protected tidal marsh and bay wildlife
- Bird and wildlife watching from the shoreline and nearby Bay Trail
- Parking at the far west end of Powell Street in Emeryville
- No camping
howToGetIt: No day-use fee is listed. Park at the west end of Powell Street in Emeryville and enjoy the reserve from the shoreline. State Parks notes this property may have limited public facilities while planning and development continue. Collecting or taking marine life is not allowed in a state marine reserve.
